summary.policy: If a station group is a physical boundary for multiple lines of the same operator and that line exists in the current gameplay route set, every adjacent line must include that station group in its gameplay service pattern. Lines not present in gameplay routes are reported separately as source/scope gaps, not display-membership failures.
